name: Stoner #1
title: Visitor (out of the Sharkstorm)
//: Story Phase 15: one of two very relaxed grown men the Sharkstorm spat onto the deck in their little boat (chapter 175). Slow, philosophical, kind; thinks it's all a hallucination and respects it anyway. Still aboard at the end of the phase.

name: Stoner #2
title: Visitor (out of the Sharkstorm)
//: Story Phase 15: the other visitor. Excitable, literal, delighted by everything ('Bro.'). It was his birthday.

name: Agnes the Second
title: Chicken
//: Story Phase 15: a small brown hen who came down out of the Sharkstorm on a parachute (chapter 181). Brogath named her for the Agnes of Lower Wafting. She wanders a little round wherever she's put (never far: radius 2), pecks, and sits on Brogath's foot. Blown back into the Sharkstorm by Vindicta (chapter 185): agnes_second_missing_in_sharkstorm.

name: The Branch Teller
title: Bashfulness Branch
//: Story Phase 15: the Bashfulness Branch's own teller, made of haze. Serves the night depositors; clocks out in chapter 183 (forty years, no tea break) and makes the captain RELIEF GRAND TELLER.

name: Vindicta Thunderwaft
title: Grand Stenchmistress (Unserved)
//: Story Phase 15: Grand Stenchmistress Vindicta Thunderwaft the Unserved, the last customer, who refuses to dissolve properly (chapter 185). Her blast clears the Great Mellowing out of the ship. Still trying to re-form at the end.

name: A Customer
title: Bashfulness Branch
//: Story Phase 15: the last-second customers at the closing branch (chapter 184), who can't remember their names, why they came, or which sash is theirs.
